title.en: Bias and fairness: where it comes from, how to measure it, what to do
title.zh: 偏差与公平：从哪来、怎么量、怎么办

description.en: Sources of bias along the ML pipeline, why removing the sensitive attribute is not enough, the group fairness criteria computed from confusion matrices, why they cannot all hold when base rates differ, and mitigation before, during and after training.
description.zh: 机器学习流程中偏差的来源，为什么去掉敏感属性不够，用混淆矩阵算各个群体公平准则，为什么基础率不同时它们不能同时成立，以及训练前、中、后的缓解办法。

name.zh: “不知道敏感属性”式公平与代理变量
用混淆矩阵计算公平准则
缓解：预处理、训练中、后处理

description.en: Believing that deleting the sensitive attribute makes a model fair
description.zh: 以为删掉敏感属性模型就公平

description.en: Thinking there is one correct fairness criterion that all classifiers can satisfy
description.zh: 以为存在一个所有分类器都能满足的“唯一正确”公平准则

description.en: Judging a model by overall accuracy only
description.zh: 只看总体准确率来评价模型

description.en: Forgetting that demographic parity ignores the true label Y
description.zh: 忘了人口统计均等不看真实标签 Y

title.en: ML in the world: what can go wrong
title.zh: 机器学习落地：会出什么问题

text.en: ML is used for medical diagnosis, language generation, hate-speech detection, stock prediction, insurance suggestions, spam and malware detection, predictive policing, and in the legal domain. The lecture opens with a 'quick (and biased) press review' of headlines, about: an AI tool with dual-use risk (2024); Uber and Amazon paying different wages for the same work through AI (2023); a Dutch court ruling that a welfare surveillance system violates human rights (2020); and police facial recognition that cannot tell Black people apart. The question is always: *what can possibly go wrong?*
text.zh: 机器学习被用在医疗诊断、语言生成、仇恨言论检测、股市预测、保险推荐、垃圾邮件/恶意软件检测、预测性警务和法律领域。讲义开头是一段“快速（且有偏）的新闻回顾”，标题大致是：一个有双重用途风险的 AI 工具（2024）；Uber 和 Amazon 用 AI 对同样的工作付不同的工资（2023）；荷兰法院裁定福利监控系统违反人权（2020）；警方人脸识别分不清黑人。问题永远是：*会出什么问题？*

title.en: A case study: Amazon same-day delivery (lecture)

body.en: Amazon trained a model to decide which zip codes get same-day delivery, with the goal of minimising cost and maximising efficiency. No one asked it to discriminate, but the served areas turned out to follow income. Then a **feedback loop** starts: lower-income areas order less, so they get no same-day service, so they order even less, so they get even less priority.
body.zh: Amazon 训练了一个模型来决定哪些邮编提供当日达，目标是降低成本、提高效率。没人要它歧视，但被服务的区域却跟收入走。随后出现**反馈回路**：低收入区下单少，所以没有当日达，于是下单更少，优先级更低。

title.en: Bias in humans and in data
title.zh: 人的偏差与数据的偏差

text.en: Models learn from data made by people, so human biases arrive twice: in the world the data records, and in how it is collected.
text.zh: 模型从人造的数据里学，所以人的偏差来两次：一次在数据所记录的世界里，一次在数据的收集方式里。

rows.en: seeing out-group members as less nuanced than our own
rows.zh: 觉得外群体成员比自己人单调
巧克力消费与诺贝尔奖得主

rows.en: even a random sample reflects the world as it was, with its biases we do not want to carry forward
rows.zh: 哪怕随机抽样也反映过去的世界，连同我们不想延续的偏见

rows.en: data does not represent the whole population: minorities under-represented; obvious facts under-reported, anomalies and positive results over-reported
rows.zh: 数据不能代表全体：少数群体不足；显而易见的事实少被报告，异常和正面结果被过度报告
Gordon 与 Van Durme (2013) 的论文

rows.en: (1) noisy measurement that is not random across groups; (2) a noisy proxy taken for the label of interest; (3) oversimplifying the quantity
rows.zh: (1) 噪声不是随机地分布在各群体间；(2) 把带噪的代理当成真正关心的标签；(3) 把量过度简化

rows.en: arrest records more detailed in some postcodes; "hiring decision" as a proxy for "applicant quality"; politics as Democrat vs Republican only

alt.en: The ML pipeline: world, data, model, individuals, with a feedback loop; orange tags show where each kind of bias enters.
alt.zh: 机器学习流程：现实世界、数据、模型、个人，加上反馈回路；橙色标签表示各种偏差在哪里进入。

rows.en: **Model fit:** weak models have high bias; unjustified assumptions
rows.zh: **模型拟合：** 弱模型偏差大；不合理的假设

rows.en: carefully consider model assumptions; model groups separately
rows.zh: 仔细考虑模型假设；对各群体分别建模

rows.en: **Biased loss:** 0/1 loss tolerates errors in the minority class on highly imbalanced data
rows.zh: **有偏的损失：** 数据高度不平衡时，0/1 损失容忍少数类的错误

rows.en: test set unrepresentative; overfitting to a popular benchmark; a metric that hides minorities (high accuracy though non-Caucasian faces are missed)
rows.zh: 测试集不具代表性；对热门基准过拟合；掩盖少数群体的指标（准确率高，但认不出非白人面孔）

rows.en: choose metrics and test sets carefully; use several metrics
rows.zh: 仔细选指标和测试集；用多个指标

rows.en: a system used in ways it was not intended for; end-users not educated
rows.zh: 系统被用于设计之外的用途；使用者没有被教育

prompt.en: A model is 95% accurate on a majority group of 900 people and 70% on a minority group of 100. What is the overall accuracy, and what does it hide?
prompt.zh: 一个模型在 900 人的多数群体上准确率 95%，在 100 人的少数群体上 70%。总体准确率是多少，它掩盖了什么？

feedback.en: The groups have different sizes, so the overall accuracy is the size-weighted average, not the plain mean.
feedback.zh: 两个群体大小不同，总体准确率是按人数加权的平均，不是简单平均。

label.en: 92.5%; the 25-point gap for the minority is invisible in it
label.zh: 92.5%；少数群体 25 个百分点的差距在其中看不出来

feedback.en: Overall accuracy is not the minimum; it is dominated by the larger group.
feedback.zh: 总体准确率不是最小值，而是被大群体主导。

explain.en: (900 × 0.95 + 100 × 0.70) / 1000 = 0.925. A single average hides how much worse the model is for the small group: this is **evaluation bias**, so report metrics per group.
explain.zh: (900 × 0.95 + 100 × 0.70) / 1000 = 0.925。一个平均数掩盖了小群体上模型差多少：这就是**评估偏差**，所以要按群体分别报告指标。

title.en: Sensitive attributes and the metrics we will use
title.zh: 敏感属性与要用到的指标

text.en: Notation: **X** the non-sensitive features, **A** the sensitive attribute with discrete values (male/female, old/young, ...), **Y** the true label, **Ŷ** the predicted label. The groups are the values of A. It is rarely clear which attributes are sensitive, and the choice matters a lot.
text.zh: 记号：**X** 非敏感特征，**A** 取离散值的敏感属性（男/女、老/少……），**Y** 真实标签，**Ŷ** 预测标签。群体就是 A 的各个取值。哪些属性算敏感往往不明确，而这个选择影响很大。

text.en: **The running example** (lecture): a bank classifier decides *grant credit / no credit*. Features: credit history, job, wealth. The protected attribute is the applicant's species: **martians** (minority) or **humans** (majority). Fairness means making fair decisions for both. For fairness criteria we compute these metrics **separately for each group** and compare.
text.zh: **贯穿的例子**（讲义）：银行分类器决定*批/不批信贷*。特征：信用记录、工作、财富。受保护属性是申请人的物种：**火星人**（少数）或**人类**（多数）。公平就是对两类人都做出公平的决定。公平准则要求把这些指标**按群体分别算**再比较。

title.zh: “不看敏感属性”为什么行不通：代理变量

say.en: **Fairness through unawareness:** hide the sensitive features, train on $X$ only and remove $A$. The hope: if $A$ is not an input it cannot matter.
say.zh: **“不看敏感属性”式公平：** 把敏感特征藏起来，只用 $X$ 训练、去掉 $A$。希望：$A$ 不是输入，就不会有影响。

say.en: But $X$ may be correlated with $A$. Say the only feature is the postcode $Z$ (1 or 2), and martians mostly live in postcode 1 (the lecture's hint: schools and education on Mars differ from Earth's). 30% of applicants are martians.
say.zh: 但 $X$ 可能和 $A$ 相关。设唯一的特征是邮编 $Z$（1 或 2），火星人大多住在邮编 1（讲义的提示：火星的学校和教育水平与地球不同）。30% 的申请人是火星人。

say.en: Bayes: the postcode *reveals* the group. Knowing $Z = 1$ makes 'martian' about 63% likely, against a 30% prior. $A$ is redundantly encoded in $X$: $Z$ is a **proxy**.
say.zh: 贝叶斯：邮编*暴露*了群体。知道 $Z=1$，“火星人”的可能性约 63%，先验只有 30%。$A$ 被冗余地编码在 $X$ 里：$Z$ 是一个**代理变量 (proxy)**。

say.en: Historical bias: in the training data, applicants from postcode 1 were approved less often. A model with only $Z$ learns exactly this, and predicts 'grant' for postcode 2 only (0.7 > 0.5).
say.zh: 历史偏差：训练数据里，邮编 1 的申请人被批准得少。只用 $Z$ 的模型恰好学到这点，只对邮编 2 预测“批”（0.7 > 0.5）。

say.en: The grant rate by group: the model never saw $A$, yet martians get credit 20% of the time and humans 80%: a **four-fold gap**. Unawareness made no difference to the outcome.
say.zh: 各群体的批准率：模型从没见过 $A$，可火星人只有 20% 获批，人类 80%：差了**四倍**。“不知道”对结果毫无改善。

outro.en: So hiding $A$ is not enough: remove it *and* every proxy and you often lose the useful features too. Fairness has to be **measured** with $A$ in hand, which is what the criteria do. Note that fairness *through awareness* uses $A$ to check and correct.
outro.zh: 所以光藏起 $A$ 不够：把它*和*所有代理变量都删掉，往往有用的特征也没了。公平必须在手里有 $A$ 的情况下去**度量**，这就是各种准则做的事。注意“通过知道来公平 (fairness through awareness)”正是用 $A$ 来检查和纠正。

prompt.en: Write $P(A{=}m \mid Z{=}1)$ with Bayes' rule from the numbers above.
prompt.zh: 用贝叶斯公式和上面的数字写出 $P(A{=}m \mid Z{=}1)$。

rows.zh: **群体公平 / 人口统计均等**（独立性）

rows.en: ignores Y: may grant the right people in one group and wrong ones in the other; can harm the minority's reputation
rows.zh: 不看 Y：可能在一个群体里批对的人，在另一个里批错的人；可能伤害少数群体的声誉

rows.en: the score itself matters: it should mean the same across groups
rows.zh: 分数本身重要：它在各群体里应有同样含义

rows.en: takes Y into account, but accepts and amplifies unfairness in the ground truth
rows.zh: 用到了 Y，但接受并放大真实标签里已有的不公平

rows.en: $P(\hat{Y}{=}0 \mid Y{=}1, A{=}m) = P(\hat{Y}{=}0 \mid Y{=}1, A{=}h)$, i.e. equal FNR (and TPR)
rows.zh: $P(\hat{Y}{=}0 \mid Y{=}1, A{=}m) = P(\hat{Y}{=}0 \mid Y{=}1, A{=}h)$，即 FNR（和 TPR）相等

rows.en: you do not want to miss a qualified person
rows.zh: 不想漏掉任何一个合格的人

rows: $P(\hat{Y}_i{=}1 \mid A_i, X_i) \approx P(\hat{Y}_j{=}1 \mid A_j, X_j)$ if $s(X_i, X_j) > \theta$

rows.en: you can define similarity of people
rows.zh: 能定义人与人的相似度时

rows.en: needs a similarity function sim() (often non-trivial) and a threshold θ
rows.zh: 需要相似度函数 sim()（常常很难定）和阈值 θ

body.en: The textbook names the three families: **independence** ($\hat{Y} \perp A$, demographic parity), **separation** ($\hat{Y} \perp A \mid Y$: equal TPR *and* equal FPR, called **equalised odds**; equal opportunity is its TPR half) and **sufficiency** ($Y \perp A \mid \hat{Y}$: equal PPV and equal NPV; predictive parity is its PPV half). The conflict result in a later page is about these.
body.zh: 教科书把它们分成三类：**独立性**（$\hat{Y} \perp A$，人口统计均等）、**分离性**（$\hat{Y} \perp A \mid Y$：TPR *和* FPR 都相等，称**均等化赔率 (equalised odds)**；机会均等是它的 TPR 一半）、**充分性**（$Y \perp A \mid \hat{Y}$：PPV 和 NPV 都相等；预测均等是它的 PPV 一半）。后面的冲突结论讲的就是这些。

title.en: Worked example: the credit classifier, three ways
title.zh: 算例：信贷分类器，三种预测

say.en: The ground truth of the lecture example. Martians (m): 12 applicants, 6 would repay. Humans (h): 18, of whom 6 would repay. So the **base rates** $p$ differ: 0.50 vs 0.33.
say.zh: 讲义例子的真实情况。火星人 (m)：12 人，6 人会还款。人类 (h)：18 人，其中 6 人会还款。所以**基础率** $p$ 不同：0.50 对 0.33。

say.en: The first classifier grants credit to 4 martians (1 truly good, 3 not) and 6 humans (5 good, 1 not). Counting the circles on the slide.
say.zh: 第一个分类器批给 4 个火星人（1 个真的好，3 个不好）和 6 个人类（5 个好，1 个不好）。数的是讲义图里的圆点。

say.en: **Demographic parity**: grant rate per group. Equal (1/3): satisfied.
say.zh: **人口统计均等**：各群体的批准率。相等（1/3）：满足。

say.en: **Equal opportunity**: of those who would repay, how many are granted? 17% of good martians against 83% of good humans: violated.
say.zh: **机会均等**：会还款的人里有多少被批？好火星人 17%，好人类 83%：不满足。

say.en: **Predictive parity**: of those granted, how many are good? 25% of granted martians, 83% of granted humans: violated. This is the lecture's warning about demographic parity: it grants the right humans but mostly the wrong martians 'without any penalty', which also damages the minority's reputation.
say.zh: **预测均等**：被批的人里有多少是好的？被批火星人 25%，被批人类 83%：不满足。这正是讲义对人口统计均等的警告：批对了人类，却大多批错了火星人，而“毫无惩罚”，还会损害少数群体的声誉。

intro.en: Take the lecture's example, with its picture turned into counts. Each of the three classifiers is built to satisfy one criterion.
intro.zh: 拿讲义的例子，把它的图变成计数。三个分类器各自被调成满足一个准则。

prompt.en: Write the martians' grant rate $P(\hat{Y}{=}1 \mid A{=}m)$ as a fraction.
prompt.zh: 把火星人的批准率 $P(\hat{Y}{=}1 \mid A{=}m)$ 写成分数。

title.en: The same people, three classifiers: which criterion holds?
title.zh: 同样的人，三个分类器：哪个准则成立？

items.en: **1** equalises the grant rate (0.33 = 0.33) but TPR and PPV are far apart.
items.zh: **1** 批准率相等（0.33 = 0.33），但 TPR 和 PPV 差得很远。

items.en: **2** has PPV 0.50 = 0.50 (and the same grant rates, 4/12 = 6/18) but TPR is 0.33 vs 0.50.
**3** has TPR 0.67 = 0.67 but the grant rates differ (0.42 vs 0.28).

text.en: The criteria give *different* verdicts on the same people. Accuracy also differs: 0.67, 0.60, 0.80 overall; refusing everyone would already score 0.60. The lecture's message: **no fair free lunch**.
text.zh: 同样的人，几个准则给出*不同*的结论。准确率也不同：整体分别是 0.67、0.60、0.80；全部拒绝也有 0.60。讲义的信息：**没有公平的免费午餐**。

title.en: A hint of what comes next

body.en: Classifier 3 happens to have equal TPR *and* equal PPV (both 4/5 = 0.80 in its two groups' granted lists), yet its FPR is 0.17 vs 0.08. That is no accident: with different base rates it cannot be otherwise. The next chapter shows why.
body.zh: 分类器 3 碰巧 TPR *和* PPV 都相等（两个群体被批名单里都是 4/5 = 0.80），但 FPR 是 0.17 对 0.08。这不是巧合：基础率不同时就只能如此。下一章讲为什么。

title.en: Why the criteria conflict: one identity
title.zh: 为什么准则会冲突：一个恒等式

say.en: Write PPV with the group's **base rate** $p = P(Y{=}1 \mid A)$. Out of $N$ people, $Np$ are positive, so $TP = \text{TPR}\cdot Np$; $N(1-p)$ are negative, so $FP = \text{FPR}\cdot N(1-p)$. $N$ cancels.
say.zh: 用群体的**基础率** $p = P(Y{=}1 \mid A)$ 写出 PPV。$N$ 个人里，$Np$ 个正例，所以 $TP = \text{TPR}\cdot Np$；$N(1-p)$ 个负例，所以 $FP = \text{FPR}\cdot N(1-p)$。$N$ 约掉。

say.en: Invert and split the fraction.
say.zh: 取倒数并拆开分式。

say.en: Subtract 1 from both sides.
say.zh: 两边减 1。

say.en: Solve for FPR. **This ties the four quantities together** in every group.
say.zh: 解出 FPR。**这个式子在每个群体里把四个量绑在一起。**

say.en: Demand predictive parity **and** equal opportunity in two groups. Then FPR is forced to differ by the ratio of the base-rate odds. If $p_A \ne p_B$ the FPRs differ, unless FPR is 0 in both (which needs PPV = 1: a perfect classifier) or TPR = 0 (a useless one).
say.zh: 要求两个群体同时满足预测均等**和**机会均等。那么 FPR 被迫相差基础率赔率之比。只要 $p_A \ne p_B$，FPR 就不同；除非两边 FPR 都是 0（这要求 PPV = 1：完美分类器）或 TPR = 0（无用的分类器）。

intro.en: With different base rates, group fairness criteria cannot all hold for an imperfect classifier. Here is the reason, from the definitions of PPV, TPR and FPR.
intro.zh: 基础率不同时，对一个不完美的分类器，各群体公平准则不可能同时成立。下面从 PPV、TPR、FPR 的定义出发说明原因。

outro.en: This is the **impossibility result** (Kleinberg et al. 2016; Chouldechova 2017; textbook). The same style of argument shows demographic parity and equalised odds conflict too: a perfect classifier has $\hat{Y} = Y$, so its grant rate equals the base rate and differs between groups.
outro.zh: 这就是**不可能性结果**（Kleinberg 等 2016；Chouldechova 2017；教科书内容）。同样的论证可以说明人口统计均等和均等化赔率也冲突：完美分类器的 $\hat{Y} = Y$，批准率等于基础率，而基础率在各群体间不同。

prompt.en: Solve the previous line for FPR.

text.en: Two groups with different base rates: group A has 50% positives, group B 20%. Take a classifier with the **same error rates** in both: TPR = 0.8, FPR = 0.2. Per 1000 people:
text.zh: 两个群体基础率不同：A 有 50% 正例，B 有 20%。取一个两群体**错误率相同**的分类器：TPR = 0.8，FPR = 0.2。每 1000 人：

text.en: Equal TPR and FPR (equalised odds) holds, but PPV is 0.80 for A and 0.50 for B: a 'grant' means much less in B, because B has few positives and the same 20% of the many negatives are wrongly granted. To raise B's PPV to 0.80 while keeping TPR = 0.8, the identity says FPR for B must be 0.05: B's FPR is now 0.05 vs A's 0.20. Predictive parity and equal FPR cannot be had together.
text.zh: TPR、FPR 相等（均等化赔率）成立，但 A 的 PPV 是 0.80，B 只有 0.50：在 B 里“批”的含金量低得多，因为 B 正例少，而庞大的负例里同样的 20% 被错批。想在 TPR = 0.8 不变时把 B 的 PPV 提到 0.80，由恒等式 B 的 FPR 必须是 0.05：B 的 FPR 是 0.05，A 的是 0.20。预测均等与 FPR 相等不能兼得。

alt.zh: 左：TPR 与 FPR 相等，则 PPV 不等。右：强行让 PPV 相等（TPR 相等），则假阳性率不等。

body.en: There is no neutral answer: choose the criterion that matches the harm. The textbook example is a recidivism-risk score (COMPAS): its makers stressed equal PPV across groups, critics stressed unequal false positive rates, and both were right about their own criterion. The escape routes are equal base rates or a perfect classifier, neither of which a real problem gives. The lecture's advice is to know what matters (representation, the meaning of the score, missing a qualified person) and to trade off against accuracy.
body.zh: 没有中立的答案：要按所关心的伤害来选准则。教科书里的例子是再犯风险评分（COMPAS）：开发方强调各群体 PPV 相同，批评者强调假阳性率不同，两边对各自的准则都没说错。出路只有基础率相等或完美分类器，现实问题两者都不给。讲义的建议是：先弄清什么重要（代表性、分数的含义、不漏掉合格者），再和准确率做权衡。

title.zh: 预处理：重采样与重加权

say.en: What we would see **if $A$ and $Y$ were independent**: the product of the margins.
say.zh: **如果 $A$ 与 $Y$ 独立**，我们会看到什么：边缘概率之积。

say.en: What the data shows: the actual share of that cell.
say.zh: 数据里实际的占比：该格子的比例。

say.en: Weigh each instance by expected over observed: over-represented cells (more than independence predicts) get weight below 1, under-represented cells above 1. The lecture states it for $Y{=}1$; the same holds for $Y{=}0$.
say.zh: 每个样本的权重是期望除以观察：被过度代表的格子（比独立时多）权重小于 1，不足的格子大于 1。讲义对 $Y{=}1$ 写出，$Y{=}0$ 同理。

say.en: On the lecture's 30 applicants: 12 martians, 12 good in total (6 + 6).
say.zh: 用讲义的 30 个申请人：12 个火星人，共 12 个好人（6 + 6）。

say.en: Good martians are over-represented: they make up 0.20 of the data, but only 0.16 if $A$ and $Y$ were independent. So the weight is below 1.
say.zh: 好的火星人在数据里占 0.20，而独立时只应占 0.16：被过度代表，所以权重小于 1。

say.en: The other three cells in the same way. Bad martians and good humans, which are rarer than independence predicts, get weight 1.2.
say.zh: 其余三个格子同样算。比独立时更少见的“差火星人”和“好人类”，权重是 1.2。

say.en: Check: in the weighted data both groups have the same positive rate, 0.40 = $P(Y{=}1)$. Any model trained on it sees no link between $A$ and $Y$.
say.zh: 检验：加权后的数据里，两个群体的正例率相同，都是 0.40 = $P(Y{=}1)$。在它上面训练的模型看不到 $A$ 和 $Y$ 之间的联系。

intro.en: Pre-processing fixes the data before any model sees it. **Balancing**: up-sample the minority group or down-sample the majority. **Re-weighting**: keep all instances, give each a weight that makes $A$ and $Y$ look independent.
intro.zh: 预处理在任何模型见到数据之前修数据。**平衡：** 对少数群体过采样，或对多数群体欠采样。**重加权：** 保留所有样本，给每个样本一个权重，让 $A$ 和 $Y$ 看起来独立。

text.en: Use a fairness criterion as a **constraint** while training (minimise the loss *subject to* the second line) (the lecture's example: logistic regression with demographic parity). **Pro:** fairness is built directly into training. **Con:** the optimisation problem is more complex. (Textbook variants: add the unfairness as a penalty term to the loss, or train an adversary that tries to predict $A$ from the model's output while the model tries to fool it.)
text.zh: 训练时把公平准则当作**约束**（在满足第二行的前提下最小化损失；讲义的例子：带人口统计均等约束的逻辑回归）。**优点：** 公平直接放进训练。**缺点：** 优化问题更复杂。（教科书变体：把不公平程度当惩罚项加进损失；或训练一个对手，从模型输出去预测 $A$，模型则努力骗过它。）

text.en: Change the predictions of a trained model, for example choose the threshold θ per group, or give a special rule to instances with $P(\hat{y}) \approx 0.5$.
text.zh: 改动已训练模型的预测，比如按群体分别选阈值 θ，或对 $P(\hat{y}) \approx 0.5$ 的样本给特殊规则。

text.en: Toy scores for 12 martians and 18 humans (the lecture's sizes). With a single threshold 0.5 the TPR is 0.50 for martians and 0.83 for humans. Lowering the martians' threshold to 0.4 gives both 0.83: **equal opportunity**. The price: martians' FPR rises to 0.33 (humans: 0.17), so equalised odds still fails, as the identity predicts. Here the overall accuracy happens to rise from 0.73 to 0.80 because 0.5 was a poor threshold for martians; in general a constraint cannot beat the best unconstrained accuracy.
text.zh: 12 个火星人和 18 个人类（讲义的人数）的玩具分数。统一阈值 0.5 时，火星人 TPR 0.50，人类 0.83。把火星人的阈值降到 0.4，两者都是 0.83：**机会均等**。代价：火星人的 FPR 升到 0.33（人类 0.17），所以均等化赔率仍然不成立，正如恒等式预言的。这里总体准确率恰好从 0.73 升到 0.80，是因为 0.5 对火星人本来就不合适；一般来说，约束不可能超过无约束时的最佳准确率。

title.en: The three stages and the trade-off

rows.en: any model afterwards; fairness before learning
rows.zh: 之后可用任何模型；在学习之前就公平

rows.en: the fix is indirect: the model may still find proxies
rows.zh: 修正是间接的：模型仍可能找到代理变量
公平直接成为训练的一部分
优化更复杂；依赖具体模型

rows.en: model-independent; works with black-box and proprietary models
rows.zh: 与模型无关；黑箱/专有模型也能用

rows.en: needs the protected attribute at test time
rows.zh: 测试时需要受保护属性

text.en: **No fair free lunch** (lecture, Hardt et al. 2016): the 'fair' predictions differ under different criteria, it is difficult and in some cases provably impossible to satisfy them all, and there is often a trade-off between fairness and overall performance. In their loan example, how many *non-defaulters* get a loan in each ethnic group is very different under max-profit, a single threshold, equal opportunity, equalised odds and demographic parity: the choice of criterion changes who gets the loan.
text.zh: **没有公平的免费午餐**（讲义，Hardt 等 2016）：“公平”的预测在不同准则下不同；要全部满足很难，有时被证明不可能；公平与整体表现之间常常要取舍。在他们的贷款例子里，各族群里*不违约者*拿到贷款的比例，在利润最大、单一阈值、机会均等、均等化赔率和人口统计均等下相差很大：选哪个准则，就改变了谁能贷到款。

prompt.en: A hospital screening model must not miss sick patients in any group. Which criterion matches that aim best?
prompt.zh: 医院的筛查模型不能漏掉任何群体里的病人。哪个准则最贴合这个目标？

feedback.en: That equalises the rate of positive predictions and ignores who is truly sick.
feedback.zh: 它让正向预测的比率相等，不管谁真的有病。

feedback.en: That equalises how often a positive prediction is right (PPV), not how many sick people are caught.
feedback.zh: 它让阳性预测的正确率 (PPV) 相等，而不是抓到多少病人。

label.en: Equal opportunity: the same TPR in every group
label.zh: 机会均等：各群体 TPR 相同

feedback.en: Hiding the attribute does not control any error rate, and proxies leak it anyway.
feedback.zh: 藏起属性并不控制任何错误率，代理变量照样泄露它。

explain.en: 'Do not miss a qualified person' is a statement about the true positives caught: TPR (FNR) per group.
explain.zh: “不漏掉合格的人”说的是抓到的真阳性：每个群体的 TPR（FNR）。

prompt.en: Group A has TP = 45, FN = 15, FP = 20, TN = 120. Group B has TP = 24, FN = 16, FP = 10, TN = 50. What is the absolute difference in TPR between the groups (the equal-opportunity gap)? Give it as a decimal.
prompt.zh: 群体 A：TP = 45，FN = 15，FP = 20，TN = 120。群体 B：TP = 24，FN = 16，FP = 10，TN = 50。两群体 TPR 之差的绝对值（机会均等差距）是多少？用小数表示。

explain.en: TPR = TP/(TP+FN): A 45/60 = 0.75; B 24/40 = 0.60. Difference 0.15. FP and TN are not used.

prompt.en: In a data set of 30 applicants, 12 belong to group m and 6 of the 12 have Y = 1; in total 12 of the 30 have Y = 1. Using $W = P_{e}(A{=}a, Y{=}y)/P_{o}(A{=}a, Y{=}y)$, what is the weight of an instance with A = m and Y = 1?
prompt.zh: 30 个申请人的数据里，12 个属于群体 m，其中 6 个 Y = 1；30 个人里总共 12 个 Y = 1。用 $W = P_{e}(A{=}a, Y{=}y)/P_{o}(A{=}a, Y{=}y)$，A = m 且 Y = 1 的样本权重是多少？

prompt.en: Why can a classifier trained without the sensitive attribute A still treat groups differently?
prompt.zh: 没有敏感属性 A 训练的分类器，为什么仍可能区别对待各群体？

label.en: Other features in X are correlated with A (proxies), and historical bias in the labels is still learned
label.zh: X 里的其他特征与 A 相关（代理变量），标签里的历史偏差仍被学到

label.en: Classifiers secretly guess A from random noise
label.zh: 分类器从随机噪声里偷偷猜出 A

feedback.en: It is not noise: it is real correlation between features such as postcode and group.
feedback.zh: 不是噪声：是邮编之类特征与群体之间的真实相关。

label.en: Removing A makes the model underfit, which is unfair
label.zh: 去掉 A 会让模型欠拟合，所以不公平

feedback.en: Underfitting is a separate matter; the issue here is information that survives in X.
feedback.zh: 欠拟合是另一回事；这里的问题是信息仍留在 X 里。

label.en: It does not fail: removing A guarantees demographic parity
label.zh: 它不会失败：去掉 A 就保证人口统计均等

feedback.en: Nothing guarantees that. In the postcode example the grant rates were 0.2 vs 0.8.
feedback.zh: 没有任何保证。邮编的例子里批准率是 0.2 对 0.8。

explain.en: Information about A is redundantly encoded in X, and the labels carry the history. The model recovers both.
explain.zh: A 的信息被冗余地编码在 X 里，标签又带着历史。模型两者都能还原。

prompt.en: Two groups have different base rates. Which combination can an imperfect classifier NOT satisfy together (in general)?
prompt.zh: 两个群体基础率不同。一个不完美的分类器（一般而言）不能同时满足下面哪一组？

label.en: Equal TPR and equal FPR in both groups
label.zh: 两群体 TPR 相等且 FPR 相等

feedback.en: That is equalised odds; it can be satisfied on its own (then PPV differs).
feedback.zh: 那是均等化赔率；单独可以满足（此时 PPV 会不同）。

label.en: Equal PPV together with equal TPR and equal FPR
label.zh: PPV 相等，同时 TPR 相等、FPR 相等

feedback.en: Nothing in the identity rules that out.
A single criterion on its own can usually be met, for instance by adjusting thresholds.
feedback.zh: 单个准则通常可以满足，例如调阈值。

explain.en: $\text{FPR} = \frac{p}{1-p}\frac{1-\text{PPV}}{\text{PPV}}\text{TPR}$: with equal PPV and TPR, FPR must differ when $p$ differs.
explain.zh: $\text{FPR} = \frac{p}{1-p}\frac{1-\text{PPV}}{\text{PPV}}\text{TPR}$：PPV 和 TPR 相等时，$p$ 不同则 FPR 必不同。

title.en: Which stage, and what is the catch?

prompt.en: A bank cannot retrain its proprietary scoring model, so it applies a different score threshold to each group to equalise TPR. What stage is this and what is its main drawback?
prompt.zh: 银行无法重训其专有评分模型，于是对各群体用不同的分数阈值来使 TPR 相等。这是哪个阶段，主要缺点是什么？

label.en: Pre-processing; it changes the training data
label.zh: 预处理；它改变训练数据

feedback.en: The training data and model are untouched here.
feedback.zh: 这里训练数据和模型都没动。

label.en: In-processing; it makes the optimisation harder
label.zh: 训练中处理；它让优化更难

feedback.en: There is no training involved at all.

label.en: Post-processing; it needs the protected attribute at prediction time
label.zh: 后处理；预测时需要受保护属性

label.en: Post-processing; it only works with logistic regression
label.zh: 后处理；只适用于逻辑回归

feedback.en: The opposite: it is model-independent and works even for black boxes.
feedback.zh: 恰好相反：它与模型无关，黑箱也适用。

explain.en: It changes only the predictions (model-independent), but the group must be known when predicting.
explain.zh: 它只改预测（与模型无关），但预测时必须知道群体。

title.zh: 人口统计均等 vs 机会均等

prompt.en: In 2-3 lines: compare demographic parity and equal opportunity. Say what each equalises and when each is appropriate.
prompt.zh: 用 2-3 行比较人口统计均等和机会均等：各自让什么相等，各适用于什么情形。

key_points.en: Demographic parity: P(Yhat=1|A) equal across groups, independent of the true label Y
key_points.zh: 人口统计均等：各群体 P(Ŷ=1|A) 相等，与真实标签 Y 无关

key_points.en: Equal opportunity: TPR (equivalently FNR) equal across groups, uses Y among truly positive instances
key_points.zh: 机会均等：各群体 TPR（等价于 FNR）相等，在真正的正例里用到 Y

key_points.en: Demographic parity suits cases where representation matters; it can grant wrong people in one group
key_points.zh: 人口统计均等适合代表性重要的场景；可能在一个群体里批错人

key_points.en: Equal opportunity suits cases where you do not want to miss qualified people; it accepts unfairness already in the labels
key_points.zh: 机会均等适合不想漏掉合格者的场景；它接受标签里已有的不公平

model_answer.en: Demographic parity requires the same rate of positive predictions in every group, P(Yhat=1 | A=a), whatever the true label; it fits cases where representation matters but can give the right people to one group and the wrong ones to another. Equal opportunity requires the same true positive rate (equivalently the same false negative rate) in every group, so qualified people are equally likely to be found; it uses the true label, which means it also accepts any unfairness already in the ground truth.
model_answer.zh: Demographic parity requires the same rate of positive predictions in every group, P(Yhat=1 | A=a), whatever the true label; it fits cases where representation matters but can give the right people to one group and the wrong ones to another. Equal opportunity requires the same true positive rate (equivalently the same false negative rate) in every group, so qualified people are equally likely to be found; it uses the true label, which means it also accepts any unfairness already in the ground truth.

explain.en: Marking: what is equalised (grant rate vs TPR), whether Y is used, and a use case for each.
explain.zh: 评分点：各自让什么相等（批准率 vs TPR）、是否用到 Y，以及各自的使用场景。

title.en: Design: a hiring screen (Section C style)
title.zh: 设计题：简历筛选系统（C 部分风格）

prompt.en: A company wants an ML system to shortlist job applicants, trained on ten years of its own past hiring decisions. Identify two sources of bias, say which fairness criterion you would monitor and why, and propose one mitigation at each of the three stages.
prompt.zh: 公司想用机器学习给求职者筛选入围名单，用自己十年的招聘决定来训练。指出两个偏差来源，说明你会监测哪个公平准则及原因，并在三个阶段各提出一项缓解措施。

key_points.en: Sources: historical bias (past decisions reflect old discrimination) and measurement bias (hiring decision is a proxy for applicant quality); also proxies such as postcode or school
key_points.zh: 来源：历史偏差（过去的决定反映旧歧视）和测量偏差（录用决定只是申请人质量的代理）；还有邮编、学校等代理变量

key_points.en: Criterion with reason, e.g. equal opportunity: qualified applicants of each group should be equally likely to be shortlisted (or demographic parity if representation is the goal)
key_points.zh: 选一个准则并说明理由，如机会均等：各群体里合格申请人入围的机会应相同（若目标是代表性则选人口统计均等）

key_points.en: Pre-processing: reweigh or resample so A and Y look independent; in-processing: add a fairness constraint or penalty; post-processing: group-specific thresholds
key_points.zh: 预处理：重加权或重采样使 A 与 Y 看起来独立；训练中：加公平约束或惩罚；后处理：分群阈值

key_points.en: Mention that removing gender alone does not work because of proxies, and the trade-off with accuracy
key_points.zh: 提到只删性别无效（代理变量），以及与准确率的取舍

model_answer.en: Two sources: historical bias (ten years of past decisions carry the discrimination of the past) and measurement bias (the hiring decision is only a noisy proxy for applicant quality), plus proxies such as school or postcode that encode gender or ethnicity, so just dropping the attribute is not enough. I would monitor equal opportunity: applicants who would perform well should have the same chance of being shortlisted in every group, so the TPR per group should match, and I would report all metrics per group, not only overall accuracy. Mitigation: pre-processing by reweighing instances so the protected attribute and the label are independent; in-processing by training with an equal-opportunity constraint; post-processing by choosing a score threshold per group (which needs the attribute at decision time). Each step trades some accuracy for fairness, and not all criteria can be satisfied together when base rates differ.
model_answer.zh: Two sources: historical bias (ten years of past decisions carry the discrimination of the past) and measurement bias (the hiring decision is only a noisy proxy for applicant quality), plus proxies such as school or postcode that encode gender or ethnicity, so just dropping the attribute is not enough. I would monitor equal opportunity: applicants who would perform well should have the same chance of being shortlisted in every group, so the TPR per group should match, and I would report all metrics per group, not only overall accuracy. Mitigation: pre-processing by reweighing instances so the protected attribute and the label are independent; in-processing by training with an equal-opportunity constraint; post-processing by choosing a score threshold per group (which needs the attribute at decision time). Each step trades some accuracy for fairness, and not all criteria can be satisfied together when base rates differ.

explain.en: A strong answer names the sources, picks one criterion with a reason, covers all three stages, and mentions proxies and the trade-off.
explain.zh: 好答案要点：写出偏差来源，选一个准则并说明理由，三个阶段都覆盖，并提到代理变量和取舍。

items.en: **Sources of bias:** historical, representation/reporting, measurement (data); model fit and loss (model); evaluation; deployment; plus the feedback loop. Human biases: out-group homogeneity, correlation fallacy.
items.zh: **偏差来源：** 历史、代表性/报告、测量（数据）；模型拟合与损失（模型）；评估；部署；还有反馈回路。人的偏差：外群体同质性、相关性谬误。

items.en: **Unawareness** (drop A) fails: proxies encode A and labels carry history.
items.zh: **不看属性**（去掉 A）会失败：代理变量编码了 A，标签带着历史。

text.en: Different base rates $p$ therefore rule out equal PPV, equal TPR and equal FPR all at once.
text.zh: 所以基础率 $p$ 不同，就不可能 PPV、TPR、FPR 同时都相等。

items.en: **Mitigation:** pre (resample, reweigh $W = P_{e}/P_{o}$), in (constraint or penalty), post (group thresholds: model-independent, needs A at test time).
items.zh: **缓解：** 预处理（重采样、重加权 $W = P_{e}/P_{o}$）、训练中（约束或惩罚）、后处理（分群阈值：与模型无关，测试时需要 A）。

items.en: **No fair free lunch:** criteria conflict and trade off against accuracy; choose by the harm to avoid; report metrics per group.
items.zh: **没有公平的免费午餐：** 准则相互冲突，并与准确率取舍；按要避免的伤害来选；分群报告指标。
